pain_points.statement: Finance is three weeks behind on invoicing due to data discrepancies.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

pain_points.statement: Delayed invoicing is causing a significant cash flow problem.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Three weeks of revenue we should have invoiced is just sitting there.

desired_state.statement: The client prefers a fixed-fee structure with milestone payments.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Strong preference for fixed-fee with milestone payments over T&M.

desired_state.statement: A pilot must be in production by the end of Q3.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Pilot in production by end of Q3 (Sept 30).

success_criteria.statement: Reduce days-sales-outstanding to the industry standard of five days.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: days-sales-outstanding, which should drop from where we are now back to industry standard

success_criteria.statement: The project should pay for itself by avoiding future headcount hires.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: pays for itself in headcount we don't have to hire next year.

risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Otherwise the funding gets pulled into other projects.

risks_unknowns.statement: The engagement is competitive, with two other firms in consideration.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: This is a competitive engagement — they are also talking to two other firms.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers must manually enter data across three disconnected systems.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce

pain_points.statement: The driver mobile app lacks essential features like photo uploads and messaging.
pain_points.source_excerpt: They can't take photos, they can't flag issues, they can't message the dispatcher.

desired_state.statement: The technical approach should focus on incremental change rather than a full system rebuild.
desired_state.source_excerpt: incremental change instead of a full rebuild.
desired_state.contradiction_note: VP Ops Sarah Chen wants incremental change to meet the 6-month timeline, but CTO Marcus Patel has been pushing for a full rebuild of the dispatch tool.

success_criteria.statement: The solution must avoid creating new compliance work for the ELD mandate.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: avoid creating new compliance work for him

risks_unknowns.statement: Technical integration from two recent acquisitions remains incomplete.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers spend hours on the phone because the driver app is inadequate.
pain_points.source_excerpt: spend two to three hours a day on the phone with drivers

pain_points.statement: Finance staff are overwhelmed doing manual detective work to reconcile invoices.
pain_points.source_excerpt: They have one person doing it full-time and she's drowning.

desired_state.statement: Fixing the invoicing reconciliation is the highest priority, followed by dispatcher workflow.
desired_state.source_excerpt: invoicing is the bleeding wound. We need to fix that first.

success_criteria.statement: Reduce average dispatch time per load from twelve minutes to eight minutes.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: average dispatcher takes about twelve minutes... get that to eight minutes

risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: ELD compliance deadline in November — federal mandate update.

desired_state.statement: Start with a smaller Phase 1 engagement to prove value and earn future phases.
desired_state.source_excerpt: I'd rather come in at the lower end and earn the next phase
